programs.title: Preludes and Fugues
programs.desc: Bach, Brahms, Buxtehude, and Boulay. An evening built on the form the organ does best.

programs.title: Bach and Franck
programs.desc: The two poles of the organ repertoire on one program, from the Leipzig chorales to the Chorale in B minor.

programs.title: Music from Ages Past
programs.desc: Baroque and before, on organ or harpsichord, as given for the Madrigali Singers in Ojai.

programs.title: The Sacred Music of Spain and Latin America
programs.desc: Padilla, Ginastera, Villa-Lobos, and Colón, with the Spanish baroque at the harpsichord. Available as a recital, a lecture-recital, or a choral program with the presenter's choir.

programs.title: Latin American Styles at the Organ
programs.desc: A lecture-recital on improvising for worship in the styles of Latin America, developed for GIA's Summer Music Institute.

programs.title: Requiems
programs.desc: Mozart, Fauré, Duruflé, Palestrina, or Trotta's Seven Last Words, prepared with the presenter's choir over a residency.

technical: Organ recitals are played on the presenter's instrument; he asks for practice time on the instrument the day before and the day of the concert, and a registrant if the console requires one. Harpsichord programs need a tuned instrument at A=415 or A=440 as agreed in advance. For choral residencies he sends scores and rehearsal plans six weeks ahead. Travel and hospitality are arranged through Seven Eight Artists.
